technology_name: Gravity Compensation Hydraulic Damper for Postural Transients
constitutional_basis: Directive section 10: the causal chain must be explicit; the decisive experiment must compare against a REAL baseline architecture; do not merely show that the mechanism moves fluid. Constitution Art. XLVII (baseline supremacy) and Art. XX (problem existence).

causal_chain.physics: dP_gravity = rho * g * dh; postural range up to ~50 cm H2O (~37 mmHg) recorded in the buyer equation registry (EQ-1)

causal_chain.event: Hydrostatic/gravitational pressure transient appears across the shunt
causal_chain.physics: The postural step changes total driving pressure: dP_total = dP_valve + dP_gravity - dP_damper (EQ-3)

First-order fluid response: dQ/dt = (dP_total - dP_gravity - c_h*Q)/I_h; damping element provides hydraulic resistance proportional to flow: F = c*v, dP_damper = c_h*Q (EQ-2/EQ-4); settling ~5*tau, tau = I_h/c_h (EQ-5)
causal_chain.class: MODELLED — comparative advantage over ASD UNKNOWN (the dossier's own status label)

causal_chain.physics: The annular damping gap (shipped: 0.18 mm after the KEEP mutation; c_h ~ 1/gap^3, MODELLED, relative change x4.63) attenuates the flow transient amplitude and settling behavior
causal_chain.class: COMPUTATIONAL_RESULT (gap, measured on built solid) + MODELLED (c_h)

causal_chain.physics: Attenuated postural flow excursions vs the standard/ASD architectures across the postural pressure set (10/20/30/40 mmHg)

what_the_device_does: A passive hydraulic damper inline with the CSF shunt that damps postural flow transients — a compressible-element/annular-gap proportional resistance element reacting to the hydrostatic pressure step of posture change, rather than a binary anti-siphon membrane or a programmable valve setting.
what_the_baseline_is: ASD (anti-siphon device) — the incumbent passive gravity-compensation architecture — plus the standard valve catheter as the null baseline. The R339 buyer package comparison table covers 4 postures at 10/20/30/40 mmHg: damper vs ASD vs standard.

the_honest_finding.quote: ASD is BETTER than P-24 at target-flow matching in 3/4 postures. P-24's advantage is proportional response and faster modeled dynamics — neither yet established as clinically material.
the_honest_finding.vvuq_label: COMPUTATIONALLY_SUPPORTED_BUT_UNCERTAINTY_SENSITIVE — 78.8 % of the modeled parameter ensemble meets target

differentiators.claim: Response speed (0.1 s vs 0.5 s class; quantitative value 0.4 s recorded)
differentiators.materiality_evidence: NONE — postural transitions take 1-3 seconds; the recorded note is that the speed difference may be clinically immaterial

differentiators.claim: Proportional control (smooth, continuously varying resistance vs binary anti-siphon switching)
differentiators.materiality_evidence: NONE — no model of ICP oscillation as a function of valve binary-switching exists

decision_recorded: The two unestablished advantages (response speed, proportional control) become the decisive experiment's primary endpoints. If bench data shows neither is clinically material, P-24 enters the repair pipeline; if repair fails, cemetery (R339 g3 decision, quoted in PORTFOLIO_COMMERCIAL_STATE.json).
problem_existence_gaps: The clinical harm model of postural over-drainage transients (vs steady-state over-drainage, which ASDs already address) is the premise this package must defend — the differentiation audit records no established clinical materiality for EITHER differentiator
0 established advantages over the incumbent ASD is the honest starting position; the package is a hypothesis about two unestablished differentiators, not an improvement claim
loop_verification_state: SYNTHETIC_LOOP_VERIFIED (the only non-NONE state in the buyer portfolio; R339 11-step Article-XXXV loop on synthetic observations — 'Posterior is NOT reality-informed') — never to be presented as physical validation
